headline_marked: Pakistan, Turkiye to [[deploy military forces to Saudi Arabia]] under Makkah Pact
headline: Pakistan, Turkiye to deploy military forces to Saudi Arabia under Makkah Pact
summary: The three nations agreed to activate collective defence commitments to counter security threats facing the kingdom.
details: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkiye have agreed to rapidly deploy military forces and capabilities within the kingdom to address security threats.
The decision was made during an emergency meeting of the Strategic Political and Defence Committee (SPDC) of the Makkah Defence Alliance in Riyadh.
While the statement did not name a specific threat, the move comes amid ongoing Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabian cities and economic facilities.
The alliance members strongly condemned attempts to target Makkah and Madina, reaffirming their rejection of any threat to the kingdom's territorial integrity.
Pakistan's Defence Minister Khawaja Asif stated that while Saudi troops handle combat operations, Turkish and Pakistani armies currently play a supportive role.
He noted that Pakistan is specifically involved in reconnaissance, while providing other necessary assistance to the Saudi armed forces.
As part of the alliance's institutional growth, Pakistan's retired Lieutenant General Nauman Mahmood has been appointed as the first secretary general for a three-year term.
The high-level meeting included Pakistan's Deputy PM Ishaq Dar and Army Chief Field Marshal Asim Munir, alongside their Saudi and Turkish counterparts.
caption:
Pakistan and Turkiye are moving to deploy troops to Saudi Arabia. The Makkah Pact is now being put into practical action.

Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkiye have agreed to rapidly deploy military forces and capabilities within the kingdom to address security threats.

The decision was made during an emergency meeting of the Strategic Political and Defence Committee (SPDC) of the Makkah Defence Alliance in Riyadh.

While the statement did not name a specific threat, the move comes amid ongoing Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabian cities and economic facilities.

The alliance members strongly condemned attempts to target Makkah and Madina, reaffirming their rejection of any threat to the kingdom's territorial integrity.

Pakistan's Defence Minister Khawaja Asif stated that while Saudi troops handle combat operations, Turkish and Pakistani armies currently play a supportive role.

He noted that Pakistan is specifically involved in reconnaissance, while providing other necessary assistance to the Saudi armed forces.

As part of the alliance's institutional growth, Pakistan's retired Lieutenant General Nauman Mahmood has been appointed as the first secretary general for a three-year term.

The high-level meeting included Pakistan's Deputy PM Ishaq Dar and Army Chief Field Marshal Asim Munir, alongside their Saudi and Turkish counterparts.

headline_marked: End of an era: [[Messi prepares for final match]] for Argentina
headline: End of an era: Messi prepares for final match for Argentina
summary: The 39-year-old legend shared an emotional message after his last training session, calling them 'special moments that I know I will miss'.
details: Lionel Messi is preparing for an emotional farewell to the Argentine national team. The 39-year-old forward shared heartfelt photos from his final training session at the Ezeiza complex, reflecting on the special moments he will miss.

His final match is scheduled for Wednesday against Benin at the Monumental Stadium. The event is expected to be a packed house, with special guests and artists joining the celebrations to honor the football icon.
Messi's international career has been legendary, highlighted by leading Argentina to the 2022 FIFA World Cup title in Qatar and winning the Copa América twice.

The farewell will also coincide with the retirement of Nicolas Otamendi from international football. Other key World Cup-winning players like Rodrigo De Paul and Julian Alvarez are expected to feature in the lineup.
For fans, this match marks the end of an unforgettable era of success and historic achievements, transitioning from early struggles to the pinnacle of global football glory.
caption:

Lionel Messi is bidding farewell to the Argentine national team.

Lionel Messi is preparing for an emotional farewell to the Argentine national team. The 39-year-old forward shared heartfelt photos from his final training session at the Ezeiza complex, reflecting on the special moments he will miss.

His final match is scheduled for Wednesday against Benin at the Monumental Stadium. The event is expected to be a packed house, with special guests and artists joining the celebrations to honor the football icon.

Messi's international career has been legendary, highlighted by leading Argentina to the 2022 FIFA World Cup title in Qatar and winning the Copa América twice.

The farewell will also coincide with the retirement of Nicolas Otamendi from international football. Other key World Cup-winning players like Rodrigo De Paul and Julian Alvarez are expected to feature in the lineup.

For fans, this match marks the end of an unforgettable era of success and historic achievements, transitioning from early struggles to the pinnacle of global football glory.
